subject: P0 E2 HANDOFF: Beta2 wake call lineage defect confirmed; containment model 8/8 PASS
body: Two-cycle E2 support lane complete. SOURCE finding: Beta2's transformed retrying Fold7ContinuityCoordinator.wakeInner weakens the baseline transaction boundary by allowing stale generation while opening, omitting the immediate IO pre-invocation generation/connectionEpoch recheck, deriving proof from current topology, and retrying with controller.generation. Shell WAKE_INNER_DISPLAY carries no generation/attempt token and can mutate physical NORMAL plus a matched 1968x2184 logical route. MODEL: eight adversarial interleavings were evaluated; current Beta2 semantics met the fail-closed safety expectation in 2/8, while the proposed request-lineage containment contract met 8/8. Minimal fix: capture original generation + connectionEpoch; revalidate both immediately before call and on handler return; stale result is evidence only; retry the same original generation, never controller.generation. Do not blindly compensate a stale physical wake because a newer legitimate opening may own it. This is not claimed causal for the physical first-open crash or late useful pixels. No production writes.
recommended_patch_invariants: same request generation at enqueue, pre-invocation, and post-result
same Shizuku connectionEpoch at enqueue, pre-invocation, and post-result
stale result cannot become readiness proof
no blind rollback of stale physical wake without independent ownership fence
